text: Reset your password in the self-service portal: choose Forgot password and enter the code from the authenticator app.
An account locks after five wrong password attempts. It unlocks by itself after 15 minutes, or the helpdesk can unlock it.
Two-factor codes come from the authenticator app. After getting a new phone, re-enrol the app before wiping the old phone.
Production database access is granted per project by the data owner and expires after 30 days unless renewed.
Join the Larkspur-Staff Wi-Fi with your normal username and password. Guests use Larkspur-Visitor with the daily code from the front desk.
Install the Larkspur VPN client from the software portal and connect before opening the wiki, ticket system or file shares from home.
If the VPN connects but internal sites do not load, disconnect, wait ten seconds and reconnect. Report the client's error code if it persists.
Slow Wi-Fi in a meeting room usually means too many devices. Use a wired desk or ask for the floor's access point to be checked.
Laptops are replaced every four years. Your manager requests a new one through the hardware catalogue.
A flickering or black laptop screen is a hardware ticket. Do not open the case yourself.
Report a lost or stolen phone or laptop to IT at once so it can be locked and wiped remotely.
If a printer shows offline, restart it, then remove and re-add it from the Printers page.
Meeting room screens support wireless casting. If casting fails, plug in the HDMI cable at the table.
Engineers can request a second monitor or a docking station with their manager's approval; delivery takes about a week.
Request new software with a ticket giving the business reason and the cost centre. Approved software appears in the portal within two working days.
Open source tools still need approval because of licence terms.
Container tooling and local databases are pre-approved for engineering laptops and can be installed from the portal.
Restart your laptop after updates when asked. Delaying more than three days locks the laptop until it is updated.
Report phishing with the Report button in your mail client. Do not forward the message.
If you clicked a link in a suspicious email, tell the helpdesk straight away and change your password.
Keep disk encryption and automatic updates switched on. IT checks compliance every night.
Shared folders and mailboxes are granted by their owner. Ask the helpdesk for the owner, who approves the request in the ticket.
Access is reviewed every six months and unused access is removed.
Finance staff must use a hardware security key for the payments system; ask the helpdesk to issue one.
